description: The course discusses the principles of classical mechanics within a rigorous mathematical framework. Topics may include kinematics, conservative forces, central-force motion, small oscillations, rigid bodies, variational problems, the Lagrangian and Hamiltonian formalisms, non-inertial frames, and special relativity. This course is a prerequisite for most of the Major courses in Physics.
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must have completed all of YSC1213/YSC1216 at a grade of at least D )
